fact: U-NIEWS Issue 88 (15 March-15 April 2024), the government's monthly multi-hazard bulletin, reports NDVI anomaly and NDVI curves for 26 Feb-6 March 2024 with advisories to farmers.
title: U-NIEWS Monthly National Integrated Multi-Hazard Early Warning Bulletin, Issue 88
publisher: Office of the Prime Minister, Department of Relief, Disaster Preparedness and Management (NECOC)
